close_reason: Already addressed: yqo.9 added auth-bypass doc warning to register_mail_handlers. Duplicate finding.
description: lib.rs register_mail_handlers: the Dispatcher generic C (caller context) is silently discarded in ClosureHandler::call. The doc comment warns about this, but it is a public API footgun: any server that needs per-request auth (tenant id, bearer token, ACL) cannot use register_mail_handlers and must re-implement handler registration. Since the docs say 'implement JmapHandler directly', the risk is that most implementors will use register_mail_handlers, discover auth is absent, then either hack auth into the backend (wrong layering) or file an issue. The API design should be reconsidered before it fossilizes — consider making C a type parameter to the handler closures, or providing a second registration function that includes C.
title: register_mail_handlers silently drops per-request auth context C
